_comment: The 161 hooks rewritten by hand from raw TikTok fragments into natural Peninsular
Spanish. Merged over hooks_manual.json by build_captions.py (this file wins).
Written as the phrases people actually type: '¿cómo se dice X en inglés?',
'¿cómo se pronuncia X?', 'X o Y: cuál se usa'. Phrasing is varied on purpose —
216 titles all opening '¿Cómo se dice' would read as machine-stamped and would
cannibalise each other in the same video block.
Keywords carried naturally: inglés, clases, pronunciación, vocabulario. The barrio
and 'academia de inglés' are appended as a geo suffix by build_captions.py, so they
